We have added the SKIP button in the current version for people who want to use it to help them collect photographs and ending scenes more quickly.

For our Chinese-speaking consumers, we have also provided simplified and traditional Chinese language options.

Don't pass up this fantastic opportunity if you haven't already become the game owner!!! From today through the 19th of October.

notes.title: Charming Heart is available now and ready for download for only 11.99$
notes.content:
Charming Heart, The Four Celestial Angels, and the Magic Items, an enchanting and immersive visual novel game with a gripping tale and multiple options, is now available for download on Steam for only 11.99$!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44127612/00483e19d2e247c5f0c156fbd313ed9badf00549.jpg[/img]

The plot centers around Nut, an ordinary young man experiencing his lowest point in life at a university. He is often bullied by his pals and taunted by The Four Celestial Angels, who obstruct his love for "Mew," the girl of his dreams. However, when Nut stumbles upon a mysterious shop, his life takes a dramatic turn.

The story begins here, and whether Nut's dreams come true or not is up to you to uncover and reveal!

notes.title: Finally, the wait is over! The official release date is July 14th.
notes.content:
Charming Heart, a fascinating visual novel game for gamers aged 18+ developed in Thailand, will be available on Steam soon. The official release date is July 14th. 

In Charming Heart, you'll take on the role of "Nut," who is harassed by the four mischievous Celestial Angels. They also prevent you from contacting "Mew," your crush. The story revolves around revenge, deep mysteries, and lewdness, and the outcome depends on your choices!

The full game includes:
-       Rich content with six chapters for your delightful enjoyment, along with English translation.
-       Full voice acting for the main characters in every scene.
-       Multiple endings based on your choices.
-       Achievement trophies to unlock on Steam.
-       Gallery to view past scenes and images.
-       Game acceleration by holding down the Ctrl key.
-       Option to mute/unmute the voice of the main character, "Nut."
-       Press the Esc key to access the emergency screen.

Get ready for the release on July 14th!
